description: This is a PHP source file defining the CompanyStructureService class, which manages company subunit data, including CRUD operations and hierarchical retrieval within an HR management system.

classes.name: CompanyStructureService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods for managing organizational subunits, including retrieval, creation, deletion, and hierarchy management within the company structure.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureDao
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of CompanyStructureDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setCompanyStructureDao
methods.description: Sets the CompanyStructureDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: getSubunitById
methods.description: Fetches a subunit entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: saveSubunit
methods.description: Saves or updates a subunit entity.

methods.name: addSubunit
methods.description: Adds a child subunit to a parent subunit, establishing hierarchy.

methods.name: deleteSubunit
methods.description: Deletes a specified subunit and its descendants.

methods.name: setOrganizationName
methods.description: Updates the root organization name in the company hierarchy.

methods.name: getSubunitTree
methods.description: Retrieves the hierarchical tree of subunits up to a specified depth.

methods.name: getSubunitArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of subunits excluding the root node.

methods.name: getSubunitChainById
methods.description: Builds and returns an array of subunit IDs representing the chain from a specific subunit up to the root node.
